argv: run-as org.packrag.product.test sh -c 'set -eu; root=files/f2-full-assets-0001; test -d files; test ! -L files; test -d "$root"; test ! -L "$root"; test -f "$root/owner.marker"; test ! -L "$root/owner.marker"; test "$(wc -c < "$root/owner.marker")" -eq 26; test "$(cat "$root/owner.marker")" = "PackRAG F2 full assets v1"; for entry in "$root"/* "$root"/.[!.]*; do if test -e "$entry" || test -L "$entry"; then case "${entry##*/}" in owner.marker|full-generator.asset|full-template.asset|full-tokenizer.asset|full-encoder.asset) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac; fi; done; test -f "$root/full-generator.asset"; test ! -L "$root/full-generator.asset"; test "$(wc -c < "$root/full-generator.asset")" -eq 1593894944; test -f "$root/full-template.asset"; test ! -L "$root/full-template.asset"; test "$(wc -c < "$root/full-template.asset")" -eq 5443; test -f "$root/full-tokenizer.asset"; test ! -L "$root/full-tokenizer.asset"; test "$(wc -c < "$root/full-tokenizer.asset")" -eq 25301672; test -f "$root/full-encoder.asset"; test ! -L "$root/full-encoder.asset"; test "$(wc -c < "$root/full-encoder.asset")" -eq 390004608; sha256sum "$root/full-generator.asset" "$root/full-template.asset" "$root/full-tokenizer.asset" "$root/full-encoder.asset"'

scope: Exact four retained test-UID source inputs reverified read-only; no copies or installations; no host model export, arbitrary paths, custody traversal or product permissions.
